name: Kairox Systems
description: Autonomous drones that fly and swim

founders.name: Joel Santiago-Baretti
founders.bio: Founder at Kairox Systems. BS in Engineering from MIT. IEEE published for an underwater counter-drone solution. Previous founder @ stealth startup, where I designed ruggedized edge-compute devices for combat medics. Other experience: a custom gaming platform for a wounded veteran, 3D printed quadcopters, helped design a sleep apnea device.

founders.name: Jorge Cavazos
founders.bio: Founder at Kairox Systems. Previously lead ADCS engineer at Oligo Space, responsible for control law design, magnetorquer fabrication, and hardware-in-the-loop qualification. Designed self-regulating membrane testing systems at MIT Bioinstrumentation Lab. BS in Aerospace Engineering from MIT.

founders.name: Alex Rice
founders.bio: Founder at Kairox Systems. Previously at Draper Laboratory, MIT Lincoln Laboratory, NASA Johnson Space Center, and the MITRE Corporation. Published in IEEE OCEANS for underwater threat interception framework. BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science from MIT.

name: Keres
description: Kill the drone, keep the jet. Reusable unmanned interceptors.

founders.name: Parker Jamieson
founders.bio: Founder & CEO at Keres (YC F26). Previously served 11 years as a USAF pilot, including F-16 and U-28A Evaluator Pilot roles. Led cadet training operations at HQ AFROTC. Currently IMA to NORAD J3 in the Air Force Reserve. Educated at the U.S. Air Force Academy and École de l'air et de l'espace.

founders.name: Christopher Palazzolo
founders.bio: Co-founder/CTO at Keres (YC F26). Previously Head of Operations at H3X Technologies. Spent 4+ years at Boom Supersonic, rising from Aircraft Technician to Director of Aircraft and Production Operations for the XB-1 supersonic demonstrator. Led avionics, flight test, and manufacturing. BS in Mechanical Engineering from Oakland University.

description: Snake-like robots for maintenance inside machinery.

founders.bio: Co-Founder at Nuum Robotics

founders.name: Mark Seemann
founders.bio: Co-Founder at Nuum Robotics

name: Colony
description: Long-range drone network for world data collection

founders.name: Rad El Gharbi
founders.bio: Founder and CEO of Colony. Previously a particle physicist at the Stanford Linear Accelerator Center doing research in dark matter and neutrino experiments. Started in high school at 17 years old with Harvard's Particle Physics and Cosmology lab. Served as an infantryman in the Canadian Armed Forces.

founders.name: Igor Martins
founders.bio: Founder & CTO at Colony (YC W27), leading end-to-end development of autonomous, long-range VTOL aircraft for aerial data acquisition, taking it from concept to flight. Originally from Brazil, I am a Mechatronics Engineering student at the University of Waterloo. Previously engineered automated manufacturing systems and optimized production at Musashi Seimitsu, Magna, and Angstrom Fiber. Former Waterloo Rocketry Design Team member.
